fleet.summary: Fleet metadata sync and the Terminal Wall snapshot builder. Secrets are refused, never replicated; RUNNING requires a witnessed output change.

knowledge.summary: The persistent knowledge map and module context packs. The map is a map; current code and git are the source of truth.

planner.summary: Bug Planner to Executor contract: spec levels, completeness gate, difficulty triage, developer assist, budgets, and the FAST_FIX/NORMAL/SAFE classifier.

policy.summary: Canonical Work Policy, its loader, subset loading and execution bindings.

procedures.summary: Runbook registry. Metadata plus a link, never a script body. Green results are cached by dependency fingerprint.

queue.summary: Task queue and its state machine. RUNNING never goes straight to COMPLETED; it passes VERIFYING. Completion evidence is read after the instruction sentence.

security.summary: Three-tier read policy and output redaction before any payload leaves.

work_runtime.summary: Work runs, approvals, progress and the coordinator tick. Lanes are opt-in via the '-work' session suffix, decided in work_eligibility.

work_ui.summary: Server-rendered dashboard templates: Terminal Wall, Fleet, Audit, Work. Each template is a separate HTML constant in one module.
